company.name: CARS24
company.shortDescription: CARS24 is as AutoTech company that utilizes technology and dealer network for buying and selling pre-owned cars.
company.description: CARS24 offers a tech-enabled marketplace used for buying and selling pre-owned cars. It aims to revolutionize how used cars are sold by creating an efficient and reliable way for car owners to sell their used cars at a reasonable price. It utilizes an AI-enabled pricing algorithm that displays the accurate market price as well as the appraisal price of a vehicle. The platform also books appointments for vehicle inspection. The services provided by the company help customers sell their cars securely and efficiently.
